methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: RiverStreet Networks removed from multiple broadband deployment projects in rural Virginia after years of delays
signals.signal_reading: RiverStreet's failure to secure funding for 30,000+ rural broadband connections removes essential infrastructure for AI adoption in Southwest/Southside Virginia, entrenching shallow and concentrated patterns by preventing distributed digital participation.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab signals intentional deep capability-building outside NoVA, creating regional leadership development infrastructure that could support distributed AI fluency if it extends beyond campus walls into the broader Roanoke Valley economy.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops led by a Norfolk native targeting Hampton Roads directly addresses distributed skill-building through peer networks, signaling grassroots capacity development that could counteract metro concentration if sustained and scaled.

signals.title: Virginia Tech Researchers Use AI to Gauge Manufacturing Water Needs - GovTech
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech researchers developing AI for manufacturing water assessment demonstrates deep technical capability concentrated in academic hubs, creating specialized expertise that may not translate to broad regional adoption without deliberate knowledge transfer mechanisms.

signals.title: How AI is changing what happens to Hampton Roads' trash - The Suffolk News-Herald
signals.signal_reading: AI-driven waste management in Hampton Roads suggests platform-delivered automation enabling operational efficiency without deep technical capability-building, signaling shallow but functional adoption that distributes utility without distributing expertise.
